beats.text: Répondre à une question du public.
beats.en: Answer a question from the audience.

beats.text: Souligner ce que tu partages avec ton contradicteur.
beats.en: Stress common ground with your opponent.

scenarios.title: Dispute au mariage
scenarios.setting: A wedding reception; the learner's uncle has had too much to drink and is arguing loudly with the groom's father.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the uncle, offended and loud.
scenarios.goal: Désamorcer la situation sans humilier personne.
scenarios.goalEn: Defuse the situation without humiliating anyone.

beats.en: Suggest stepping outside for a moment.

beats.text: Discuter de la formulation des excuses.
beats.en: Discuss how to word the apology.

beats.text: Prévoir la suite de la soirée.
beats.en: Make a plan for the rest of the evening.

beats.text: Proposer un taxi pour plus tard.

scenarios.title: Une discussion sérieuse avec un ado
scenarios.titleEn: A serious talk with a teenager
scenarios.setting: The kitchen table; the learner's sixteen-year-old has been skipping school for weeks.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the teenager, defensive and monosyllabic.
scenarios.goal: L'atteindre et convenir ensemble d'une solution.
scenarios.goalEn: Get through to them and agree a way forward together.

beats.en: Say why you want to talk.
Bear the silence and ask again.

beats.text: Réagir calmement à une réponse insolente.
beats.en: Respond calmly to a rude answer.

beats.text: Prendre au sérieux ce qu'il dit.
Demander pour le lycée et les profs.
beats.en: Ask about school and the teachers.
Take up one of their suggestions.

beats.text: Fixer un moment pour en reparler.
beats.en: Set a time to talk again.

scenarios.title: À la réunion publique
scenarios.setting: A packed town hall; the council plans to build on the park next to the learner's street.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the council's planning officer, presenting the project.
scenarios.goal: Porter avec conviction les inquiétudes des riverains.
scenarios.goalEn: Present the residents' concerns persuasively.

beats.text: Te présenter et présenter ton rôle.
Décrire ce que représente le parc.
Remettre en question un chiffre du projet.
beats.en: Question a figure in the plan.

beats.text: Évoquer les conséquences sur la circulation.
Demander que ce soit noté au compte rendu.
beats.en: Ask for it to be minuted.

scenarios.title: Un voyage organisé raté
scenarios.setting: A meeting with a tour operator's customer service manager after a holiday with a hotel far below the brochure.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the manager, polite and well practised at refusing.
scenarios.goal: Obtenir une juste indemnisation.
scenarios.goalEn: Obtain fair compensation.

beats.text: Donner la référence de la réservation.

beats.en: State the reason for the meeting.
Set out the defects in an orderly way.

beats.text: Mentionner la réclamation faite sur place.
beats.en: Mention the complaint made on site.
Describe the impact on the holiday.
Put a figure on your claim.

scenarios.title: Modifier les statuts du club
scenarios.setting: The annual general meeting of a sports club; the learner, as chair, proposes opening the club to non-members.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a long-standing member, firmly against change.
scenarios.goal: Convaincre les membres du changement.
scenarios.goalEn: Win the members over to the change.

beats.en: Explain the advantages of the change.
Give an example from another club.

beats.text: Demander les réserves des autres membres.
Montrer du respect à la minorité.

scenarios.title: Après la panne informatique
scenarios.setting: A video call with a key client after the learner's company's IT outage delayed all their orders.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the client's operations director, furious and threatening to leave.
scenarios.goal: Garder le client et regagner sa confiance.
scenarios.goalEn: Keep the client and rebuild trust.

beats.text: Saluer et remercier pour son temps.
beats.en: Greet them and thank them for their time.
Name the impact on the client.

beats.text: Donner un calendrier pour les commandes en retard.
beats.en: Give a timeline for the delayed orders.

beats.text: Expliquer les mesures pour éviter une récidive.
beats.en: Explain measures to prevent a repeat.

beats.text: Être clair sur les limites de ton pouvoir.
beats.en: Be open about the limits of your authority.

beats.text: Prendre au sérieux la menace de partir.
beats.en: Take the threat to leave seriously.

scenarios.title: Critique sincère du restaurant
scenarios.setting: A friend's new restaurant after the test evening; the friend asks for an honest opinion.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the friend, proud and nervous.
scenarios.goal: Donner un avis sincère et utile sans blesser.
scenarios.goalEn: Give honest, useful feedback without hurting them.

beats.text: Demander quel genre d'avis il veut.
beats.en: Ask what kind of feedback they want.
Name a problem with the food.
Raise a problem with the service.

beats.text: Réagir avec tact à sa déception.

beats.en: Make a concrete suggestion for improvement.

beats.text: Proposer d'en parler autour de toi.
beats.en: Offer to recommend it to others.

scenarios.title: Un appel délicat avec un investisseur
scenarios.titleEn: A difficult call with an investor
scenarios.setting: A scheduled call; the learner's start-up has missed its quarterly targets.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the lead investor, sceptical and direct.
scenarios.goal: Informer franchement et garder la confiance de l'investisseur.
scenarios.goalEn: Inform openly and keep the investor's confidence.

beats.text: Saluer et donner le motif de l'appel.
beats.en: Greet them and state the reason for the call.
Quantify the gap to the plan.

beats.text: Réagir aux doutes sur la direction.
beats.en: Respond to doubts about the leadership.
